== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1450]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Isabella (Glasgow) Doig’s held baptism citation explicitly identifies Peter Glasgow, with Agnes Scott in the paired-family account. The Haddington sibling sequence and surviving census household support the specific father rather than a surname-only match.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the original Haddington OPR entry and compare residence/occupation across the sibling baptisms.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1458 Baptism: "Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database,  ( : accessed 11 July 2026),  Isabella Glasgow baptism (born 22 May 1843), daughter of Peter Glasgow & Agnes Scott, in Haddington, Haddingtonshire, Scotland;  citing Digital film/folder number: 7; FHL microfilm: 1067849; Record number: 14011773.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
